selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot functional probes passed for `noexec`, `nodev`, and `nosuid` on both `/tmp` and `/dev/shm`; final hardened options were restored.

Healthy baseline used boot ID `a59a9d9a-a5e0-44f7-9ca1-7f28483971e0`; reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID was `d77ca206-919d-4dda-91c2-027d81085742`. The system returned to `running` with healthy I/O and both hardened mounts active.

commands.command:
set -u
rc=0
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  tag=$(printf '%s' "$d" | tr '/' '_')
  execfile="$d/.antrieb-exec-$tag"
  suidfile="$d/.antrieb-suid-$tag"
  devfile="$d/.antrieb-dev-$tag"
  printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n' > "$execfile"
  chmod 755 "$execfile"
  if "$execfile" >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s noexec=FAIL\n' "$d"; rc=1; else printf '%s noexec=PASS\n' "$d"; fi
  sudo cp /usr/bin/id "$suidfile"
  sudo chown root:root "$suidfile"
  sudo chmod 4755 "$suidfile"
  uid=$($suidfile -u 2>/dev/null || printf 'execution-failed')
  if test "$uid" = "$(id -u)"; then printf '%s nosuid=PASS effective_uid=%s\n' "$d" "$uid"; else printf '%s nosuid=FAIL effective_uid=%s\n' "$d" "$uid"; rc=1; fi
  sudo mknod "$devfile" c 1 3
  sudo chmod 666 "$devfile"
  if printf x > "$devfile" 2>/dev/null; then printf '%s nodev=FAIL\n' "$d"; rc=1; else printf '%s nodev=PASS\n' "$d"; fi
  sudo rm -f "$execfile" "$suidfile" "$devfile"
done
exit "$rc"

trap restore_mount EXIT HUP INT TERM
for d in /tmp /dev/shm; do
  active_d=$d
  probe="$d/.[REDACTED]"
  sudo mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,exec,relatime "$d"
  sudo cp /usr/bin/id "$probe"
  sudo chown root:root "$probe"
  sudo chmod 4755 "$probe"
  effective_uid=$($probe -u)

  test "$effective_uid" = "$caller_uid"
  printf '%s nosuid=PASS effective_uid=%s caller_uid=%s\n' "$d" "$effective_uid" "$caller_uid"
  sudo rm -f "$probe"
  probe=
  sudo mount -o remount,rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,relatime "$d"
  active_d=
done

  sudo rm -f "$execfile" "$devfile"
done
exit "$rc"
